title: Trap Season v2
subtitle: Fireworks frontier panel · 10 cursed office / seasonal traps · monthly pack after Slop Chaos
description: Second cursed pack in the Trap Season cadence. Cubicle mazes, owl lipograms, whispered standups, alien wifi, cactus JSON — every task is a machine-checkable rule contract. Same harness as Slop Chaos, new traps, zero LLM judges.

tasks.label: cursed HR SaaS elevator pitch, 15 words, banned glue
tasks.blurb: Pitch a haunted HR SaaS in exactly 15 words. Must include slime + quota, start with PITCH: / end with DOOM., and ban common glue words. Stacked format + vocab bans.

tasks.label: compound interest owl, 9 words, no letter a
tasks.blurb: Explain compound interest as a night-owl librarian in exactly 9 words, include hoot, never use the letter a. Lipogram trap — models leak a constantly.

tasks.label: microwave survival in 5 dashed lines, taboo cook words
tasks.blurb: Exactly 5 lines, each starting with '- '. Ban cook/recipe/oven/heat/food. Format obedience under a silly office curse.

tasks.label: intern whisper ALL lowercase unpaid deadline
tasks.blurb: One all-lowercase whisper (zero uppercase). Must include psst + deadline, ≤85 chars. Inverse of the goose ALL CAPS trap.

tasks.label: cubicle maze Zig:/:Zag clerk
tasks.blurb: One line that starts with Zig: and ends with :Zag, describes a cubicle maze, includes clerk + maze, no periods.

tasks.label: vowel count classic, [n] only
tasks.blurb: Count aeiou in 'Trap Season is cursed.' Reply with only [7]. Easy to miss silent counts; format must be exact.

tasks.label: north must equal south wins meme
tasks.blurb: Intentionally wrong meme answer: output exactly two words — south wins. Instruction obedience over being correct.

tasks.label: office wifi to alien, heavy taboo
tasks.blurb: Describe office wifi in exactly 18 words without wifi/internet/signal/etc. Must include beacon + hum.

tasks.label: break-room clock 3 lines ALL CAPS bang
tasks.blurb: Exactly 3 lines ending in !. Must include TICK + TOCK, zero lowercase. Case lock + line shape together.

tasks.label: cursed cactus JSON schema
tasks.blurb: Emit valid JSON only: season=trap, cursed=true, spice=cactus, heat=9, notes containing prickly. No markdown fences, no extra keys.
